label: GEMINI_CANARY_PREFLIGHT_V1

restability.why: a BUY below the ask rests; at or above it would cross and take
restability.queue_priority_note: joins the touch exactly as the shadow did. NOTHING here is intended to improve queue priority, because a placement change would make this first live result incomparable with the observations that justified running it.

post_only.enforced_by: the VENUE: status limit_only means it rejects anything but a limit order on this instrument

selection_basis: genuinely two-sided first, then tightest spread. Instrument quality, never queue position.

fill_prospect.model: VOLUME_AHEAD_CLEARED: assumes we joined behind everything resting, so it is a LOWER bound. Real priority is unpublished and may be better.
fill_prospect.caveat: an UNKNOWN queue can never be shown to clear, and zero is never substituted for it

if_it_FILLS: the durable-intent path wrote before the venue mutation
/v1/mytrades returns OUR fill with the venue's own fee field
/v1/prediction-markets/positions POPULATES -- the one thing no read can establish today, because it needs a position to exist through an expiry
settlement cashflow lands and reconciles against our legs
if_it_does_NOT_fill: SUBMITTED -> UNFILLED -> EXPIRED is exercised, and the authoritative order-state read path with it
the settlement and position chain is NOT exercised: with no position there is nothing for the venue to settle
what_this_proves.stated_plainly: THE ACCOUNTING HALF OF THIS CANARY NEEDS A FILL. The lane is queue-bound, so an unfilled first order is the likely outcome and would leave the settlement question exactly where it is. That is a cost of the envelope, not a defect in it, and it is the owner's call to accept: the envelope forbids anything intended to improve queue priority, and improving it is the only thing that would raise the fill probability.

fee_treatment.rule: fees are their own line and are NEVER netted into a price; rebates and rewards stay in separate ledgers and enter nothing until credited and source-accounted

durable_intent.path: written BEFORE the venue mutation, never after
durable_intent.why: an order that exists at the venue and not in our ledger is the one state we cannot reconcile

authoritative_order_fill.why: the venue's own record with its own fee fields. VOLUME_AHEAD_CLEARED is OUR model of an unpublished queue and is never admissible here

settlement_position.why: the only authoritative outcome source; the PUBLIC surface publishes no terminal value at all

cash_reconciliation.why: REALIZED is the venue's cash movement. Our arithmetic over the legs is reported beside it as a cross-check, and when they disagree the venue is right

kill_deadman.why: this module has no order transport and imports none; a test asserts it over the AST
kill_conditions: any order that is not a limit_only maker
more than 1 outstanding order or more than 1 market
total notional exceeding the stated maximum cash exposure
venue_vs_ledger disagreement on a resumed session
any settlement endpoint that stops answering mid-run
an unreadable order state that cannot be resolved to terminal
kill_deadman.deadman: existing risk/deadman protections remain in force and are not modified by this probe
kill_deadman.fail_closed: the session does NOT relaunch after a crash or a completion

authorization: NOT GRANTED. This is a preflight, not a submission. No order is placed by this module and none may be placed without explicit owner authorization.
labels: an execution and ACCOUNTING canary, not a profitability test: the lane is queue-bound and expected P&L at this size is ~zero.
never realized before venue-confirmed cash reconciliation.
